Paragraph: "Look at the cascading waterfalls, Lakshmana! They fall like silvery sheets over the dark mountain rocks..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Beholding magnificent waterfalls plunging down mountain cliffs.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama appreciates the dynamic beauty and dramatic contrast of nature.
Outcome/Resolution: He shares a moment of visual wonder with his brother.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Nirjhara (Waterfall symbolizing continuous, uninhibited divine flow)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Waterfalls represent the energetic, continuous grace of God pouring into the dark, solid material world.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Shifting mental attention to powerful, dynamic elements in nature to disrupt repetitive sad thoughts.
